body: The fuel can is tagged for basement storage and the notebook records a test visit on the same date. The return box for the container is empty.
title: Basement supply record
gloss: A test visit and fuel container share an unfinished return record.
rival_reading: A response team could store fuel and log an inspection together; the empty return box does not identify the test.

title: Hammer beside the basement vent
body: Maintenance note: use the hammer mark to find the basement vent. Yellow dust appeared inside after the seed-treatment truck idled above it.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Fuel mark on the crop account
body: Cash receipt at the fuel mark: the crop-study truck took two cans but returned one. The driver wrote that the missing can stayed with the basement samples.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
gloss: Fuel mark on the crop account

title: Thunder Gas charged the field account
body: Fuel receipt headed “Thunder Gas”: two cans billed to the county crop trial. One can returned with a sharp herbal smell and no cap.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
gloss: Thunder Gas charged the field account

title: Hammer mark over a sealed vent
body: Photograph back at the hammer mark: the basement vent was nailed shut after yellow dust appeared inside. The treatment truck had idled directly above it.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
gloss: Hammer mark over a sealed vent

title: Basement shelf of leaf samples
body: Diary line under “basement”: leaf jars from three farms occupied the lower shelf. By morning every label had been peeled away, but the dates remained on the lids.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
